facts.fact: The APDP president describes the Digital Code (Law No. 2017-20 of 20 April 2018, amended by Law No. 2020-35 of 6 January 2021) as the law under which the authority receives declarations, handles complaints and requires compliance.
The APDP president says the authority has eight members who elect a Bureau of a president and a rapporteur.
facts.system: Autorite de Protection des Donnees a caractere Personnel (APDP)

facts.fact: The APDP president says the authority handles compliance files, trains controllers and data protection delegates yearly since 2021 and takes complaints, without naming a decision on any organisation.
